subject: Deco says Barcelona would welcome Liverpool paying 55 million euros for Araujo
title: Barca want 55m for the man they benched

lines.vo: Barcelona would happily take fifty-five million euros from Liverpool for Araujo.
lines.footage: Ronald Araujo Liverpool highlights, loan debut

lines.vo: Ronald Araujo is a twenty-seven-year-old Uruguay defender, and a former Barcelona captain.
He is on loan at Liverpool, who hold an option, not an obligation, to sign him for good.
Two goals in fifteen games for Liverpool. For a defender, that is a side hustle.
lines.footage: Ronald Araujo Liverpool goal; heading or shooting

lines.vo: At Barcelona he struggled for minutes, even as a former captain.
Now Barcelona want fifty-five million for the man they could not find minutes for.
Deco says timing and fee could still be negotiated. So fifty-five million is a conversation, not a receipt.
lines.footage: Deco press conference Barcelona, Catalunya Radio interview

lines.vo: Araujo would need new personal terms too. The player gets a vote.
lines.footage: Liverpool training ground, Araujo arrival clip

lines.vo: Deco also denies any plan to sell Alejandro Balde, who has played five matches. Loyalty, or a shortage of left-backs.
